predictions: Got the missing week 5 result right, and then tagged on a solid 18-7 record last week. And that 18-7 was even better than it looks… I nailed half a dozen scores exactly, and the seven incorrect picks were two 12-12 scores, three 13-11 scores, and two 14-10 scores. Yep, all seven would have flipped or tied on a single dart. This picking stuff is frickin' hard, man… That all takes me to 107-42 (71.8% correct) so far, and that record would be a LOT better if Trips Are For Kids would take a hike…

Match of the week: (A Div.) Element XL @ The Bullies. The league's marquee matchup (maybe "ever") brings us another undefeated matchup atop the league. As always, this pairing is dripping with national and state champions, and the odds of these teams going all the way to a tiebreaker has been higher for this pair for than any in league history. Next chapter of awesome coming up… Have to take my own team, 12-12.

Match #2: (G Div.) Dart Vader's @ That's What She Said. With Vader taking one on the chin last week, this is all of a sudden a direct head-to- head for the G lead at the midway point. Vader had lived a little bit on the edge early, so last week's blip made sense, I guess. If She Said had more consistent attendance, I would feel more confident in my pick here, but I'm still going with the possible high gear of She Said, 14-10.

Match #3: (F Div.) Rippin Darts @ Zero Dart Ton 80. Only Rippin's week 5 slip is keeping this from being another all-undefeated battle. Between these teams, they already combine for eight wins by 10+ points, so this is some serious heavyweight action. As well as Rippin has been playing, I still think this could be Zero Dart's time. Zero, 14-10.

Match #4: (E Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Runs with Corks. The E race has become one hot trio of excitement. Three 5-1s a couple wins ahead of the pack? Yes, please. And here are two of them, both of whom lost to the other 5-1. Drama, baby! Let's go Dart Side in the last 501.

Match #5: (C Div.) Hump Day! @ Off Constantly-Reboot. McGavin has streaked to a 5-0 record and has a losing record opponent tonight. So this matchup of 4-1s is more likely to see who stays within a match of the leaders than to see who jumps to the C lead yet. Off Constantly has yet to surpass 13 in any non-forfeit, so I'll take the Humpers, 14-10.

Matches #6 & #7: (B Div.) Inconsist. Consistent @ Dart Attack; Double In, Stumble Out @ Trips Are For Kids. The two B leaders each face one of the two sitting at exactly 0.500 tonight. Could be the night the B race gets reinvigorated. Or… it could be the night that somehow ends with SIX of the eight B teams having losing records (that possibility is kinda nuts, no?). These are going to be a bit tight, but six losing records it is. Attack, 13-11; Stumble, 14-10.

Match #8: (A Div.) 2 Liver Die with LA @ Lunatic Fringe. It's not likely that the top two in A will be caught, but if anyone is going to have a shot at it, it will be the winner of this premier matchup. This pick would be a lot easier if I knew who was/wasn't going to finally be in attendance (Finney? Vaughan? Lindsey?). Fringe it is, 13-11.

Match #9: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Cheap Shots. With three 2-4 teams all locked up, the race to avoid a drop to F is in full form. The closeness in E is shows by the fact that despite being 4-8 combined, these teams total only one score below 10. Let's go with DT, 13-11.
Match #10: (D Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ DD-214. There is a tight pack of FIVE 2-loss & 3-loss teams chasing Reload. This race is so wide open. This is just another one that could go either way. DD, 13-11.

Match #11: (A Div.) Why So Serious? @ Show Me Your Tips. The winner of this one will be in place to declare itself one of the league's five best teams, and will be only one win behind the loser of the Liver-Fringe match above. I think I'll take Show Me in a 1001.
Match #12: (G Div.) Bottoms Up @ Neighborhood Dart Knights. The Bottoms' fold two weeks ago took a bit of a shine off this one. Still both contenders very much alive in the G race. Bottoms, 13-11.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
B Division: Raging 13, Matt's Tab 11; Nine Lives 13, Bandits 11.

D Division: Reload 14, Machine 10; Rangers 16, She-Unit 8.
E Division: Irish Ton 15, Duck Around 9; Possee 14, Bangin 10.
